Hi Sarah / Ben —

Thanks again for hosting us on Friday. Attached is a concise workshop synthesis and an action-tracker workbook that consolidates all requests from the exec sessions. I pulled out the three priority themes we heard: 1) latency reliability guarantees for search, 2) data residency and audit traces, 3) integration timeline for single-sign-on and RBAC.

Quick asks:
- Please confirm owners for the three priority items in the tracker (column: ACME owner).
- Can we get procurement contact for contract next steps (I see procurement@acme.com on the invite; including here so they have the doc).

What I attached:
- Acme-workshop-summary.pdf — 2-page highlights + proposed next-step timelines.
- Acme-action-tracker-v1.xlsx — single sheet with action rows, current owners, suggested owners at Redwood, due dates, and status.

Next steps from our side: Monica will take lead on the SSO/RBAC workstream and Jordan will scope an SLO proposal for latency/reliability. If you'd like a 30-minute follow-up next week to align owners across legal/procurement/engineering, happy to schedule.

Hannah

Ben / team —

Thanks — I attached a one-page SLO proposal (inline below) and updated the action-tracker with the SLO row (ID: SLO-01).

SLO-01 (proposed)
- Objective: 99.9% p99 latency under production load for search API (95th percentile under typical load: 120ms).
- Measurement: rolling 7-day p99 from edge to token generation.
- Safeguard: automated fallback to lower-cost model variant if p99 breaches >3x for 10m window.
- Owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood) — propose review cadence weekly for 4 weeks post-deploy.
- Suggested due date for proposal to Acme Infra: 2026-04-01

I'll send the 30-minute invite for Wed 2026-04-07 10:00am PDT. Hannah — please confirm if you'd like to include CS.

Jordan
